import Mathlib

structure BipartiteGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def BipartiteGraph.well_formed (g : BipartiteGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def BipartiteGraph.size (g : BipartiteGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def BipartiteGraph.has_edge (g : BipartiteGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def BipartiteGraph.is_valid_coloring (g : BipartiteGraph) (colors : Array Bool) : Prop :=
  colors.size = g.size ∧
  ∀ u v, g.has_edge u v →
    u < colors.size → v < colors.size → colors.getD u false ≠ colors.getD v false

def BipartiteGraph.is_bipartite (g : BipartiteGraph) : Prop :=
  ∃ colors, g.is_valid_coloring colors

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def check_bipartite_precond (graph : BipartiteGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

/-- All directed pairs `(u, v)` with `v ∈ adj[u]`. -/
def BipartiteGraph.edgeList (g : BipartiteGraph) : List (Nat × Nat) :=
  (List.range g.adj.size).flatMap
    (fun u => ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList).map (fun v => (u, v)))

/-- Functional disjoint-set-union state with parity: `rt` is the component
representative, `col` the colour relative to that representative. -/
structure PState where
  col : Nat → Bool
  rt : Nat → Nat

/-- Process one edge: conflict inside a component ⇒ `none`, otherwise merge. -/
def pstep (st : PState) (e : Nat × Nat) : Option PState :=
  if st.rt e.1 = st.rt e.2 then
    (if st.col e.1 = st.col e.2 then none else some st)
  else
    some { col := fun x => if st.rt x = st.rt e.2 then
                             xor (st.col x) (st.col e.1 == st.col e.2)
                           else st.col x,
           rt := fun x => if st.rt x = st.rt e.2 then st.rt e.1 else st.rt x }

/-- Fold `pstep` over a list of edges. -/
def prun : PState → List (Nat × Nat) → Option PState
  | st, [] => some st
  | st, e :: es =>
      match pstep st e with
      | none => none
      | some st' => prun st' es

def PState.init : PState := { col := fun _ => false, rt := fun x => x }

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def check_bipartite (graph : BipartiteGraph)
    (h_precond : check_bipartite_precond graph) : Option (Array Bool) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  match prun PState.init graph.edgeList with
  | none => none
  | some st => some (Array.ofFn (n := graph.adj.size) (fun i => st.col i.val))
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def check_bipartite_postcond (graph : BipartiteGraph) (result : Option (Array Bool))
    (_ : check_bipartite_precond graph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some colors => graph.is_valid_coloring colors
  | none => ¬ graph.is_bipartite
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

/-- Invariant 1: relative to any valid colouring, vertices sharing a representative
have the parity recorded by `col`. -/
def GoodC (g : BipartiteGraph) (st : PState) : Prop :=
  ∀ c : Array Bool, g.is_valid_coloring c →
    ∀ x y, x < g.adj.size → y < g.adj.size → st.rt x = st.rt y →
      xor (c.getD x false) (c.getD y false) = xor (st.col x) (st.col y)

/-- Invariant 3: merges never break an already established parity. -/
def Mono (st st' : PState) : Prop :=
  ∀ x y, st.rt x = st.rt y →
    st'.rt x = st'.rt y ∧ xor (st'.col x) (st'.col y) = xor (st.col x) (st.col y)

/-- Invariant 2: all processed edges are satisfied. -/
def DoneE (st : PState) (es : List (Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ es, st.rt e.1 = st.rt e.2 ∧ xor (st.col e.1) (st.col e.2) = true

theorem Mono.refl (st : PState) : Mono st st := by
  intro x y h; exact ⟨h, rfl⟩

theorem Mono.trans' {a b c : PState} (h1 : Mono a b) (h2 : Mono b c) : Mono a c := by
  intro x y h
  obtain ⟨hr, hc⟩ := h1 x y h
  obtain ⟨hr2, hc2⟩ := h2 x y hr
  exact ⟨hr2, by rw [hc2, hc]⟩

theorem bool_merge1 : ∀ (cx cy cu cv px py pu pv : Bool),
    xor cx cv = xor px pv → xor cy cu = xor py pu → xor cu cv = true →
    xor cx cy = xor (xor px (pu == pv)) py := by decide

theorem bool_merge2 : ∀ (cx cy cu cv px py pu pv : Bool),
    xor cx cu = xor px pu → xor cy cv = xor py pv → xor cu cv = true →
    xor cx cy = xor px (xor py (pu == pv)) := by decide

theorem mem_edgeList {g : BipartiteGraph} {u v : Nat} :
    (u, v) ∈ g.edgeList ↔ g.has_edge u v := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simp only [BipartiteGraph.edgeList, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map, List.mem_range] at h
    obtain ⟨w, hw, x, hx, hxy⟩ := h
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at hxy
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hxy
    exact ⟨hw, by simpa using hx⟩
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h
    simp only [BipartiteGraph.edgeList, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map, List.mem_range]
    exact ⟨u, h1, v, by simpa using h2, rfl⟩

theorem edge_xor {g : BipartiteGraph} {c : Array Bool} (hc : g.is_valid_coloring c)
    {u v : Nat} (he : g.has_edge u v) (hu : u < g.adj.size) (hv : v < g.adj.size) :
    xor (c.getD u false) (c.getD v false) = true := by
  obtain ⟨hs, h⟩ := hc
  have hsz : c.size = g.adj.size := hs
  have hu' : u < c.size := by rw [hsz]; exact hu
  have hv' : v < c.size := by rw [hsz]; exact hv
  have hne := h u v he hu' hv'
  cases hcu : c.getD u false <;> cases hcv : c.getD v false <;>
    simp [hcu, hcv] at hne ⊢

theorem pstep_spec (g : BipartiteGraph) (st : PState) (e : Nat × Nat)
    (he : g.has_edge e.1 e.2) (h1 : e.1 < g.adj.size) (h2 : e.2 < g.adj.size)
    (hg : GoodC g st) :
    match pstep st e with
    | none => ¬ g.is_bipartite
    | some st' => GoodC g st' ∧ Mono st st' ∧
        st'.rt e.1 = st'.rt e.2 ∧ xor (st'.col e.1) (st'.col e.2) = true := by
  unfold pstep
  by_cases hrt : st.rt e.1 = st.rt e.2
  · simp only [hrt, if_pos]
    by_cases hcc : st.col e.1 = st.col e.2
    · simp only [hcc, if_pos]
      rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
      have hx := hg c hc e.1 e.2 h1 h2 hrt
      have hy := edge_xor hc he h1 h2
      rw [hy, hcc] at hx
      simp at hx
    · simp only [hcc, if_neg, if_false]
      refine ⟨hg, Mono.refl st, hrt, ?_⟩
      cases hA : st.col e.1 <;> cases hB : st.col e.2 <;> simp [hA, hB] at hcc ⊢
  · simp only [hrt, if_neg, if_false]
    set d : Bool := (st.col e.1 == st.col e.2) with hd
    set st' : PState :=
      { col := fun x => if st.rt x = st.rt e.2 then xor (st.col x) d else st.col x,
        rt := fun x => if st.rt x = st.rt e.2 then st.rt e.1 else st.rt x } with hst'
    have hmono : Mono st st' := by
      intro x y h
      have hrx : st.rt x = st.rt e.2 ↔ st.rt y = st.rt e.2 := by rw [h]
      by_cases hx : st.rt x = st.rt e.2
      · have hy : st.rt y = st.rt e.2 := hrx.mp hx
        refine ⟨by simp [hst', hx, hy], ?_⟩
        simp only [hst', hx, hy, if_pos]
        cases st.col x <;> cases st.col y <;> cases d <;> rfl
      · have hy : ¬ st.rt y = st.rt e.2 := fun hc => hx (hrx.mpr hc)
        refine ⟨by simp [hst', hx, hy, h], by simp [hst', hx, hy]⟩
    have hgood : GoodC g st' := by
      intro c hc x y hx hy hxy
      have hxu := edge_xor hc he h1 h2
      by_cases hax : st.rt x = st.rt e.2 <;> by_cases hay : st.rt y = st.rt e.2
      · -- both in the merged component
        have := hg c hc x y hx hy (by rw [hax, hay])
        simp only [hst', hax, hay, if_pos]
        rw [this]
        cases st.col x <;> cases st.col y <;> cases d <;> rfl
      · -- x merged, y not : y's representative must be st.rt e.1
        have hry : st.rt y = st.rt e.1 := by
          have : st'.rt x = st.rt e.1 := by simp [hst', hax]
          have h2' : st'.rt y = st.rt y := by simp [hst', hay]
          rw [← h2', ← hxy, this]
        have e1 := hg c hc x e.2 hx h2 (by rw [hax])
        have e2 := hg c hc y e.1 hy h1 (by rw [hry])
        simp only [hst', hax, hay, if_pos, if_neg, if_false]
        exact bool_merge1 _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ e1 e2 hxu
      · -- y merged, x not
        have hrx : st.rt x = st.rt e.1 := by
          have : st'.rt y = st.rt e.1 := by simp [hst', hay]
          have h2' : st'.rt x = st.rt x := by simp [hst', hax]
          rw [← h2', hxy, this]
        have e1 := hg c hc x e.1 hx h1 (by rw [hrx])
        have e2 := hg c hc y e.2 hy h2 (by rw [hay])
        simp only [hst', hax, hay, if_pos, if_neg, if_false]
        exact bool_merge2 _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ e1 e2 hxu
      · -- neither in the merged component
        have : st.rt x = st.rt y := by
          have hA : st'.rt x = st.rt x := by simp [hst', hax]
          have hB : st'.rt y = st.rt y := by simp [hst', hay]
          rw [← hA, ← hB, hxy]
        have := hg c hc x y hx hy this
        simp only [hst', hax, hay, if_neg, if_false]
        exact this
    refine ⟨hgood, hmono, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [hst', hrt]
    · cases hA : st.col e.1 <;> cases hB2 : st.col e.2 <;> simp [hst', hrt, hd, hA, hB2]

theorem prun_spec (g : BipartiteGraph) :
    ∀ (es : List (Nat × Nat)) (st : PState),
      (∀ e ∈ es, g.has_edge e.1 e.2 ∧ e.1 < g.adj.size ∧ e.2 < g.adj.size) →
      GoodC g st →
      match prun st es with
      | none => ¬ g.is_bipartite
      | some st' => GoodC g st' ∧ Mono st st' ∧ DoneE st' es := by
  intro es
  induction es with
  | nil =>
      intro st _ hg
      exact ⟨hg, Mono.refl st, by intro e he; simp at he⟩
  | cons e es ih =>
      intro st hall hg
      obtain ⟨he, h1, h2⟩ := hall e (by simp)
      have hs := pstep_spec g st e he h1 h2 hg
      show (match (match pstep st e with
              | none => none
              | some st' => prun st' es) with
            | none => ¬ g.is_bipartite
            | some st' => GoodC g st' ∧ Mono st st' ∧ DoneE st' (e :: es))
      cases hp : pstep st e with
      | none => rw [hp] at hs; exact hs
      | some st1 =>
          rw [hp] at hs
          obtain ⟨hg1, hm1, hr1, hc1⟩ := hs
          have hrest : ∀ f ∈ es, g.has_edge f.1 f.2 ∧ f.1 < g.adj.size ∧ f.2 < g.adj.size :=
            fun f hf => hall f (by simp [hf])
          have hih := ih st1 hrest hg1
          simp only
          cases hq : prun st1 es with
          | none => rw [hq] at hih; exact hih
          | some st2 =>
              rw [hq] at hih
              obtain ⟨hg2, hm2, hd2⟩ := hih
              refine ⟨hg2, hm1.trans' hm2, ?_⟩
              intro f hf
              rcases List.mem_cons.mp hf with rfl | hf'
              · obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := hm2 f.1 f.2 hr1
                exact ⟨hA, by rw [hB, hc1]⟩
              · exact hd2 f hf'

-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem check_bipartite_postcond_satisfied (graph : BipartiteGraph)
    (h_precond : check_bipartite_precond graph) :
    check_bipartite_postcond graph (check_bipartite graph h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  have hall : ∀ e ∈ graph.edgeList,
      graph.has_edge e.1 e.2 ∧ e.1 < graph.adj.size ∧ e.2 < graph.adj.size := by
    intro e he
    have hE : graph.has_edge e.1 e.2 := mem_edgeList.mp (by simpa using he)
    obtain ⟨hu, hv⟩ := hE
    exact ⟨⟨hu, hv⟩, hu, h_precond e.1 hu e.2 hv⟩
  have hinit : GoodC graph PState.init := by
    intro c hc x y hx hy hxy
    simp only [PState.init] at hxy
    subst hxy
    cases c.getD x false <;> rfl
  have hspec := prun_spec graph graph.edgeList PState.init hall hinit
  show check_bipartite_postcond graph
      (match prun PState.init graph.edgeList with
       | none => none
       | some st => some (Array.ofFn (n := graph.adj.size) (fun i => st.col i.val)))
      h_precond
  cases hR : prun PState.init graph.edgeList with
  | none =>
      rw [hR] at hspec
      simpa using hspec
  | some st =>
      rw [hR] at hspec
      obtain ⟨_, _, hdone⟩ := hspec
      simp only [check_bipartite_postcond]
      refine ⟨by simp [BipartiteGraph.size], ?_⟩
      intro u v hedge hu hv
      have hun : u < graph.adj.size := by simpa using hu
      have hvn : v < graph.adj.size := by simpa using hv
      have hmem : (u, v) ∈ graph.edgeList := mem_edgeList.mpr hedge
      obtain ⟨_, hxor⟩ := hdone (u, v) hmem
      have gu : (Array.ofFn (n := graph.adj.size) (fun i : Fin graph.adj.size => st.col i.val)).getD u false
          = st.col u := by
        rw [Array.getD]
        simp [hun]
      have gv : (Array.ofFn (n := graph.adj.size) (fun i : Fin graph.adj.size => st.col i.val)).getD v false
          = st.col v := by
        rw [Array.getD]
        simp [hvn]
      rw [gu, gv]
      simp only at hxor
      cases hA : st.col u <;> cases hB : st.col v <;>
        simp [hA, hB] at hxor ⊢
  -- !benchmark @end proof

`./check.sh` prints **LEAN VERIFIED**.

## What was implemented

**Algorithm: disjoint-set union with parity (weighted/bipartite union-find)** — the standard non-search algorithm for 2-colorability.

- `BipartiteGraph.edgeList` enumerates every pair `(u,v)` with `v ∈ adj[u]`.
- `PState` holds `rt : Nat → Nat` (component representative) and `col : Nat → Bool` (colour *relative* to that representative); merge is a functional pointwise re-map (no path compression, no union-by-size).
- `pstep` on edge `(u,v)`: if `rt u = rt v` the parity is already fixed, so `col u = col v` is an odd-cycle closure ⇒ `none`; otherwise merge `v`'s component into `u`'s, flipping its colours by `d = (col u == col v)` so `col u ≠ col v` afterwards.
- `prun` folds this over the edge list; success materialises `Array.ofFn` of size `n`.

## Proof structure

Three invariants, all in the `lemma` section:

1. `GoodC` — for *any* valid colouring `c` and any `x,y < n` sharing a representative, `c x ⊕ c y = col x ⊕ col y`. This is what makes `none` sound: the conflict edge gives `c u ⊕ c v = false` while the edge itself forces `true`.
2. `DoneE` — every processed edge satisfies `rt u = rt v ∧ col u ⊕ col v = true`. This is what makes `some` sound.
3. `Mono` — merges preserve existing intra-component parities, so `DoneE` survives later merges; composed transitively along the fold.

`pstep_spec` does the 4-way case split for a merge (both endpoints inside the absorbed component / both outside / the two cross cases, the latter discharged by the `decide`-proved Boolean identities `bool_merge1`/`bool_merge2`). `prun_spec` is list induction.

## Semantic audit

- Precondition `well_formed` is genuinely used — it supplies `v < n` for every `v ∈ adj[u]`, without which `GoodC` could not be applied at edge endpoints.
- Non-bipartiteness is proved from an explicit contradiction, not asserted; `GoodC`/`DoneE`/`Mono` are real invariants, no `:= True` or `:= 0` placeholders.
- Disconnected graphs need no special handling: DSU never assumes connectivity, which is exactly why I chose it over BFS (recorded in `ProofState.md` under failed approaches — BFS needs a queue-emptiness closure argument plus root equality for the conflict edge).
- Edge cases checked: `n = 0` returns `some #[]`; a self-loop `u ∈ adj[u]` hits `rt u = rt u`, `col u = col u` ⇒ `none`, which is correct; asymmetric adjacency lists are fine since the postcondition only constrains `has_edge u v` pairs, which the edge list enumerates exactly.
- No `sorry`/`admit`/axioms/`partial`/`unsafe`, no `Nat.find`, `Classical.choose`, sorting, brute force, or `decide` on the target property — the two `decide` uses are closed 8-variable Boolean identities.
- Complexity: `O(n·m)` worst case for naive merges; the functional maps add closure-depth cost on lookup. This is stated honestly in `AlgorithmPlan.md` rather than claimed as near-linear.

Remaining output is linter warnings only: an unused `h_precond` in the teacher-provided postcondition signature, and some redundant `simp` arguments I left rather than risk churn on a verified proof.

- They fold this over all edges with `prun`.
